findings.title: Cleartext SMB shares accessible on internal network
findings.description: Port scan revealed SMB (445) open on 8 internal hosts with anonymous read access to shared folders.
findings.recommendation: Disable SMBv1, require SMB signing, and restrict anonymous access.

findings.title: Weak password policy on local accounts
findings.description: Multiple local accounts have passwords shorter than 8 characters or common patterns (Season+Year).
findings.recommendation: Enforce minimum 12-character passwords with complexity requirements via GPO.

findings.title: LSASS memory exposes plaintext credentials
findings.description: Credential dump from LSASS revealed 3 plaintext domain credentials. The target does not have LSA Protection enabled.
findings.recommendation: Enable LSA Protection (RunAsPPL) and configure Credential Guard on Windows 10+ endpoints.

findings.title: Browser stores saved passwords without master password
findings.description: Chrome and Edge browser stores contained 12 saved credentials accessible without additional authentication.
findings.recommendation: Enforce browser master passwords via GPO or deploy an enterprise password manager.

findings.title: Registry Run key persistence detected
findings.description: A persistence mechanism was installed via HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run.
findings.recommendation: Monitor Run keys with EDR and restrict write access via AppLocker.

findings.title: 49 task(s) failed — partial detection possible
findings.description: Some agent tasks failed, potentially due to AV/EDR intervention or missing privileges. This may indicate partial detection.
findings.recommendation: Review failed task logs. Correlate with AV/EDR alerts to confirm detection coverage.

findings.title: Initial access achieved on all target endpoints
findings.description: Agent was successfully deployed and executed on 1 endpoint(s) without triggering security controls.
findings.recommendation: Review endpoint hardening, application whitelisting (AppLocker/WDAC), and user awareness training.
